messages:
Maria T.: Quick dress rehearsal tomorrow 10:00am PT — Meridian onboarding + exec preview. Need slide run + confirmed exec asks. Please post slide owners by EOD. Agenda: 1) run slides, 2) highlight onboarding gaps, 3) renewal risk signal + mitigation, 4) action owners & deadlines.

Jamal R.: I'll take the onboarding timeline slide (slide 3). Will update with last week's onboarding completion rates.

Ava L.: Putting latest usage chart into slide 5 now. Quick Q: which metric to show for stickiness — DAU or completions?

Connor P.: DAU looks cleaner for execs. Also can we surface the hotspot where KV cache latencies spiked? Execs will want to know impact.

Maria T.: Good call. Jamal, can you add a one-liner about residual latency and mitigation (cache warmup + sticky sessions)?

Jamal R.: Yep, will add. ETA 6pm PT.

Priya S.: I'll run note-taking + action tracker during dry run. Template I've used before:

Priya S.: ```
- Slide owners: assign
- Data snapshot: confirm numbers
- Exec asks: 2 prioritized asks
- Action tracker: owner + due date
```

Sam E.: I'll join the dry run for the exec segment. Please make the asks explicit and one-slide 'decision needed' view.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: 'Meridian Onboarding Dry Run' Thu 10:00am PT — attendees: Maria, Jamal, Ava, Connor, Priya, Sam

Ava L.: :thumbsup: I'll make the 'decision needed' slide.

Connor P.: :eyes: I have one ask — backup plan if dedicated capacity isn't provisioned before go-live. Can we add fallback model routing note?

Maria T.: Yes add it to slide 7. Also tag @eng-sre for the fallback bullet. Jamal, update action list.

Jamal R.: Adding eng-sre ask now. Also capturing renewal risk: usage plateau in week 2 — suggested play: enable targeted enablement emails + success workshop.

Priya S.: Action items I'll capture: Jamal -> onboard timeline slide + latency note (due 6pm PT), Ava -> usage chart + decision slide (due 8pm PT), Connor -> fallback plan draft + eng-sre ping (due EOD), Maria -> exec talking points + final deck (due tomorrow 8am PT), Sam -> executive alignment confirmation (will confirm by EOD).

Maria T.: Perfect. If anyone can't meet these deadlines call out now. We'll do a 30m dry run then 15m exec preview.

Connor P.: All good from me.

Ava L.: Blocked only if I don't get the final numbers from analytics. @analytics-team can you drop the week-on-week CSV?

analytics-bot: shared link to numbers: https://redwood.internal/meridian-usage.csv

Priya S.: :thumbsup: I'll incorporate that.

Maria T.: Thanks team — see you tomorrow. :rocket:
